set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 2 recall-map.

The report makes a mapping inspectable; the benchmark's mapper arms move onto the command.

Scope:
Report, migration, retirement.

Acceptance criteria:
1. recall-map writes a self-contained HTML report showing, per unit, the mapping, alternatives and reliability status; every posterior row and flow marginal it displays shows the displayed mass plus the retained remainder (E0's display court).
2. Every mapper arm in the Phase 1b leaderboards regenerates through recall-map (non-mapper rows such as Heusser, LLM labellers and human ceilings are out of scope).
3. run-arm.sh and its environment variables are removed; the tools README points to recall-map.

Gate (AGENTS.md SD2/SD6): `sbt -batch clean compileAll testAll` on the merge result, then
`sbt -batch scalafmtCheckAll scalafmtSbtCheck` as a separate run; every test task in build.sbt's
testAll alias reports bound totals (56 at 0e36a7fa, after the corpus modules were added; recount if
modules change); a named mutation witness per new guard, and each compile-time-probe mutation proved
after its own clean recompile; `cd docs-site && npm run verify:examples` when public API or examples
change; fresh-context cold review in a separate pass; the commit body states the evidence and what
it does not establish.

Size: M.
set.title: Phase 2: recall-map HTML report and benchmark migration; retire run-arm.sh
